rationale.campaign_length: 29个直接任务属于中等长度，叙事密度高但终局来得相对突然。
rationale.colonization: 路线几乎没有殖民循环。
rationale.complexity: 种族容忍、接受文化、宗教、阶层特权、守护者天命与灾难需要并行管理。
rationale.dark_story: 暗影沼泽、刺杀、种族灭绝历史和亡魂沉重，但国家路线本身以保护和救赎为主。
rationale.difficulty: 开局生存和阿哈提灾难都很危险，但站稳后军事与经济会明显改善。
rationale.diplomacy: 萨姆松巴特关系、强敌制衡和守护者体系需要联盟与外交规划。
rationale.early_pressure: 小国被更强邻国和强大法师包围，开局战争与联盟时机容错较低。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 法师塔、三角洲宝珠、反弹道护符、强力法师邻国和暗影位面共同占据重要位置。
rationale.narrative_density: 王室刺杀、鹰身女妖继承、阿赫特揭示、族群争论和兽灾赎罪形成完整故事。
rationale.tall_play: 金矿、魔力资源、堡垒、圣地和奇观建设重要，但无法替代区域扩张。
rationale.trade_economy: 豺狼人商队、哀伤河贸易和资源省经营有用，但不是独立核心机制。
rationale.warfare: 收复哀伤河、对付法师和强邻、镇压阿哈提并进入暗影沼泽都需要持续作战。

identity.appearance: 1444年人类—鹰身女妖共治王国；可形成F64普拉赫塔并保留本任务树

successors.relationship: 可选连续形成国；形成决议保留杜瓦尔卡尼任务，但更换国家理念

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 玛阿特守护者是一个由鹰身女妖战士组成的神圣骑士团，她们的使命是守护远离哀伤河的赫特教信徒。在围攻戈尔科拉的过程中，大部分人死于格丽扎迦的军队之手，但有一小部分人在杜瓦尔卡尼幸存了下来，并重新组建了玛阿特之羽，以纪念她们姐妹的殉难遗体。
description.text_en: The Upholders of Ma'at were a holy order of harpy warriors whose mission was to guard the khetist faithful who ventured away from the Sorrow. Most of the order died at the hands of Grizaka's army during the siege of Golkora, but a small chapter survived in Duwarkani and refounded themselves as the Feathers of Ma'at to commemorate the martyred bodies of their sisters.

description.text: 杜瓦尔卡尼以其勤劳的牧民和独特的红毛骆驼而闻名。这种当地品种的骆驼非常适合山坡上岩石密布、险峻的地形和稀少的草料。杜瓦尔卡尼人常常离家数月，一边赶着骆驼去觅食，一边骑在马上打猎。这些人驾驭骆驼的技巧和骆驼品种的能力使他们在曲折的山谷和峡谷中成为强劲的对手，他们可以随意从山丘和峭壁后面出现，向敌人发射箭矢。
description.text_en: Duwarkani is known for its hardy herdsmen and their distinctive red-furred camels. This local breed is well suited to the rocky and treacherous terrain of the mountainsides and the sparse forage found there. Duwarkani men are often away from home for months, driving the camels to foraging spots while hunting game from atop their mounts. The skill with which these men handle their animals and the capabilities of the breed make them fierce opponents in the twisting valleys and ravines, appearing at will from behind hills and crags to pour arrow-fire into the enemy.

description.text: 杜瓦卡尼是赫特信仰的南方前哨。它负责守卫赫特拉塔，防止蜥蜴人入侵，并确保途经赫塔佩拉的朝圣者的安全。如今，格丽扎迦的战争已经分裂了帝国，但这一使命依然存在。保护信徒。守卫赫特拉塔。引导朝圣者。
description.text_en: Duwarkani is the southern outpost of the khetist faith. Responsible for guarding Kheterata from lizardfolk incursions and ensuring the safety of pilgrims traveling through Khetapera. Now that Grizaka's war has sundered the empire, this mission remains. Protect the faithful. Guard Kheterata. Guide the pilgrims.

description.text: 杜瓦尔卡尼村庄的妻子和女儿们在山坡上修建了大型花园。她们相互竞争，通过艳丽的鲜花和雕刻的头像来展示自己村庄的财富，向远方的旅行者或山谷那边的对手炫耀村庄的名字和财富。在杜瓦尔卡尼，没有比长途跋涉后一瞥自家花园更令人喜爱的景象了。
description.text_en: The wives and daughters of the Duwarkani’s villages maintain large gardens built into the mountainsides. They compete with each other to display the wealth of their village through gaudy arrangements of flowers and carved heads that trumpet a village's name and wealth to distant travelers or rivals the valley over. There is no sight more beloved in Duwarkani than to glimpse one’s garden after a long journey.

description.text:
这位赫特拉塔历史上最伟大的管家最初只是一名普通的伊尔斯马哈普士兵。在赫特拉塔被迫向卡斯塔诺的奴隶新贵屈服的时候，门考恩斯沃特屡立战功，以前所未有的速度步步高升，直至废黜叛国的管家，重拾赫特拉塔的骄傲。在他长达65年的统治期间，卡斯塔诺人被击退，阿卡西克和布勒瓦尔的大部分地区被征服，与侏儒议会的关系得到改善，阿哈提和赫特拉塔宝石魔法诞生，三角洲侏儒和泽丽鹰身女妖融入了赫特拉塔社会。

虽然门考恩斯沃特王朝的统治随着达梅里亚人的入侵而结束，但他的名字仍然具有足够的力量，以至于克罗达莫斯统治者认为有必要将这个家族的余孽流放到他们所能想到的最偏远的赫特拉塔地区：位于暗影沼泽边缘的遥远要塞城市，即杜瓦尔卡尼。他的后代仍然统治着这里，他们的血统仅次于赫特家族本身！
description.text_en:
The greatest Steward in all of Kheterata’s long history started life as a simple Irsmahapan soldier. Serving at a time when Kheterata was forced to kowtow to the upstart slaves in Castanor, Menkaunswt’s many successes would see him rise through the ranks at an unprecedented speed, until he could depose the traitorous Steward and reclaim Kheterata’s pride. His 65 year-long reign would see the Castanorians pushed back, Akasik and much of Bulwar subjugated, a bloom in relations with the Hierarchy, the birth of the Ahati and Kheteratan gem magic, and the integration of the Delta Gnomes and Nzeri Harpies into Kheteratan society.

While the rule of Menkaunswt’s dynasty ended with the Damerian invasion, his name still carried enough power that the Crodamic rulers saw fit to banish what remained of the family to most remote part of Kheterata they could think of: the distant fortress city at the very edge of the Shadow Swamp, known as Duwarkani. Here his descendants still rule, heirs to a lineage surpassed only by the khet themselves!

description.text: 长期以来，人类和鹰身女妖一直在杜瓦尔卡尼并肩生活，人类总督和鹰身女妖女族长各自以管理者的名义统治着各自的人民。但随着赫特拉塔的权威消失，也没有管家来指挥总督和女族长，双方都认为需要建立更紧密的联盟，以确保杜瓦尔卡尼的统一领导。随着肯穆大人和萨法娜夫人的联姻，门考恩斯沃特王朝和自600年以来一直统治泽丽的杜瓦兰王朝现在已合二为一。因此，一个有资格统治整个杜瓦尔卡尼，甚至是整个赫特拉塔的继承人诞生了……
description.text_en: Humans and harpies have long lived side by side in Duwarkani, with the human governors and harpy matriarchs each ruling their respective peoples in the name of the Stewards. But with the authority of Kheterata gone, and no Stewards to command governor and matriarch, both sides agreed that a closer union was needed to ensure a united leadership of Duwarkani. With the marriage of Lord Kenmu and Lady Safana, the dynasty of Menkausnwt and the Duwaran dynasty which has ruled the Nzeri since the year 600 have now united into one. Thus was born an heir worthy to rule all of Duwarkani, and perhaps even all of Kheterata...

description.text: 装备轻便的鹰身女妖观测员与骆驼重炮相结合，让杜瓦尔卡尼的军队可以将山脉变成死亡陷阱。鹰身女妖会用燃烧的炼金照明弹或彩色粉尘罐标记目标，促使炮兵对优先目标开火。
description.text_en: Lightly equipped harpy targeters combined with camel mounted heavy guns allow the armies of Duwarkani to turn the mountains into deathtraps. The harpies mark their targets with thrown burning alchemical flares or pots of colored dust, prompting the fire of the battery on priority targets.

description.text: 曾经，克罗达莫斯王朝是赫特最伟大的仆人，第一次向赫塔佩拉和霍拉舍什的人民展示了赫特的光芒。但即使是最辉煌的王朝也会走向衰落，克罗达莫斯王朝也不例外。管家们在与布勒瓦尔人和坎诺人的小规模战争中浪费人力，而邪恶和腐败的势力就在他们的边界之外伺机而动；高高在上的大祭司们宣扬僵化的教义，全然不顾普通信徒的感受；最神圣的赫塔奇巴克特赫特一世决定将王冠送给贾赫，导致几个世纪以来异教徒们声称拥有赫特拉塔的所有权。我们的新王国是一个重新开始的机会，它的政府了解这片土地和人民的真正需求。但愿它不会重蹈覆辙。
description.text_en: Once, the Crodamic dynasty were the grandest servants of the Khet, showing the light of the Khet for the very first time to the people of Khetapera and Horashesh. But even the most illustrious dynasties can fall to decadence, and the Crodamics were sadly no different. Stewards wasted men in petty wars with Bulwari and Cannorians while the forces of evil and corruption were waiting right outside their borders, secluded High Priests proclaimed stiff doctrines with no regard for the common worshipper, and the most holy Khetarch Baqtkhet I’s decision to promise the crown to Jaher led to centuries of heathens claiming ownership over Kheterata. Our new kingdom is a chance to start fresh again, with a government that understands the true needs of the land and its people. May it not repeat the mistakes of the past.

description.text: 哀伤河管家历来在伟大的赫特拉特城统治，据说这座城市由埃利赫特在巨灵城市的废墟附近亲手建造。然而，没有哪座城尼拉密特更为神圣，它坐落于圣母哀伤河的源头，是孕育赫特拉塔乃至赫特自身的大河之源。除了这座城市的宗教意义之外，它同时位于圣母哀伤河和尼拉赫特湖的湖畔这一地理位置，也为我们的政府创造了奇迹，使人们能够在一个良好的时间框架内往返于我们庞大王国的每个角落。
description.text_en: The Stewards of the Sorrow have traditionally ruled from the great city of Kheterat, reportedly built by Elikhet himself near the ruins of a genie city. Yet there can be no holier city than Niramit, located at the very Source of the Mother’s Sorrow, the birthplace of the great river that gives life to Kheterata and even to the Khet themselves. Beyond the city’s religious significance, its simultaneous location on the shores of both the Mother’s Sorrow and Lake Nirakhet does wonders for our administration’s ability to send people to and from every corner of our kingdom on a good timeframe.

description.text: 格诺拉迦兹的恶魔豺狼人入侵了伊尔斯马哈普，南方的贵族在战斗中被屠杀殆尽，赫塔佩拉的城市既被切断了与赫特拉塔中央政权的联系，又失去了该地区传统的统治阶层。在自生自灭的情况下，不同的城市开始为各自对地区统治的不同看法而相互开战。由于该地区有许多山地防御工事，这些战争都面临着独特的困难。学习如何围攻这些山地堡垒，以及如何在它们把守的狭窄山道中穿行，使我们的将军们拥有了无与伦比的技能，能够在这一地区的艰苦条件下取得胜利。
description.text_en: As the demonic gnolls of Gnollakaz invaded Irsmahap and most of the southern nobility was slaughtered in battle, the cities of Khetapera were both cut off from the central authority of Kheterata and bereft of the region’s traditional ruling class. Left to fend for themselves, the different cities started waging war on each over their different visions for what rule of the region should look like. These wars carried unique difficulties due to the many mountain fortifications across the region. Learning how to siege these mountain forts and maneuvering through the narrow mountain passes that they guard have given our generals unmatched skill in besting the difficult conditions of this region.

description.text: 邪恶势力就在我们家门口。在稀树草原上，豺狼人在为他们的地狱主人准备祭品。在沼泽地里，鬼婆们与巨魔奴隶和人类棋子一起策划着他们的阴谋。克罗达莫斯王朝没有真正理解黑暗在他们边界的威胁，最终让他们失去了一切。我们绝不能重蹈他们的覆辙。我们的士兵必须时刻准备着抵御混乱的力量，我们的统治者也绝不能忘记一旦他们放松警惕，将会面临怎样的危险。
description.text_en: The forces of evil are ever at our doorstep. In the savannah, the gnolls prepare their sacrificial pyres for their infernal masters. In the swamp, the hags plot their schemes with troll slave and human pawn alike. The Crodamics failed to truly understand the threat of the darkness at their borders, and it ultimately cost them everything. We must never repeat their grave mistake. Our soldiers must always be ready to keep the forces of chaos at bay, and our rulers must never forget what is at stake should they lapse in their focus.

description.text: 埃利赫特的魔法之令可能是他所有法令中解释和争论最广泛的。虽然在达梅里亚占领结束和埃利赫特回归之后，每个人都同意该法令强调法师们必须利用他们的神圣天赋为赫特和赫特拉塔造福，而不是为了一己私欲败坏魔法，但如何执行该法令的具体内容却千差万别。该法令曾被用作剥夺法师自由、将他们变成被束缚的劳动力的理由，也曾被用作向由最值得信赖的法师组成的魔法监督委员会授予巨大权力和特权的理由，以及介于两者之间的所有理由。这场争论在赫塔佩拉分裂时达到了顶点，成为新独立城市之间的分界线，进而成为它们之间战争的理由。为了避免今后再发生类似的冲突，我们需要利用我们作为赫特拉塔管家的权威，对法令做出明确的解释，以便今后不会再对如何正确使用神赐之物产生疑问。
description.text_en: Elikhet’s Decree on Magic is possibly the most widely interpreted and debated of all his decrees. While everyone after the end of the Damerian Occupation and Elikhet’s Return would agree that the Decree stresses the importance of the mages to use their divine gift for the benefit of the Khet and Kheterata instead of corrupting it for their own selfish desires, the specifics on how to enforce it varies wildly. The Decree has been used as justification for stripping mages of their freedom and turning them into bound labor, investing vast powers and privileges to a magical oversight committee staffed by the most trustworthy mages, and everything in between. This controversy would come to a head during the splintering of Khetapera, when it became a dividing line between the newly independent cities, which in turn would serve as justification for war between them. To avoid similar conflicts in the future, we need to use our authority as Stewards of Kheterata to hand down the definitive interpretation of the Decree, so that there can be no future doubt on the proper use of the divine gift.

description.text: 在赫特拉塔南部，阿哈提的作用与北部有些不同。由于南方的商人需要得到保护，以免遭豺狼人的袭击，而阿哈提则希望从赫特拉特获得更多的自治权，因此两者最终会联合起来，形成以阿哈提的荣誉准则为准则的贸易行会。我们并没有意识到这是一件多么幸运的事，直到赫特拉塔分裂，许多背信弃义的北方商人阶层投靠了埃利兹纳的异教徒伪装者。这种亵渎神明的背叛行为在普拉赫塔是不可接受的。很显然，我们需要将阿哈提商人行会系统扩展到整个哀伤河，这样北方商人才能最终学会一些荣誉和纪律。
description.text_en: In the south of Kheterata, the Ahati serve a somewhat different role than they do in the north. As the merchants of the south needed protection from gnollish raids, and the Ahati wished for further autonomy from Kheterat, the two would eventually join together, forming trade guilds ruled by the Ahati code of honor. We weren’t aware of what a blessing this was until the splintering of Kheterata, when much of the treacherous northern merchant class threw their lot in with the heathen pretenders of Elizna. Such blasphemous treachery is unacceptable in Prakheta. It is clear that we need to expand the system of Ahati merchant guilds to all of The Sorrow, so that the northern merchants may finally learn some honor and discipline.

description.text: 克罗达莫斯王朝在衰落之前最令人印象深刻的壮举可能就是他们成功地将赫特之光传播得如此之远。他们的领地从海到海，在北方的科罗舍什和南方的祖瓦维姆都拥有舰队。但从赫特拉特到霍拉舍什距离遥远，又被赫塔佩拉的山脉隔开，因此管家们无法直接管理该地区。相反，他们依靠任命的总督制度，与当地统治者一起统治当地的城堡。事实证明，一旦格丽扎迦切断了霍拉舍什通往赫特拉特的道路，这对该地区来说就是灾难性的。由于没有王室的援助来维持总督们的秩序，整个霍拉舍什很快就陷入了混乱，双方的总督互相倾轧，当地国王争相从王室总督手中篡权。幸运的是，我们的首都在更南边的地方，我们可以更直接、更统一地管理这个地区。霍拉舍什人可以高枕无忧，因为他们知道，与之前的赫特拉塔人不同，我们永远不会失去对他们土地的控制。
description.text_en: Perhaps the most impressive feat of the Crodamics before their downfall was just how far they managed to spread the light of the Khet. Their domain from sea to sea, possessing fleets in both Koroshesh in the north and Zuvavim in the south. But the great distance from Kheterat to Horashesh, further separated by the mountains of Khetapera, made it impossible for the Stewards to directly manage the region. Instead, they relied on a system of appointed governors ruling the local satrapies alongside local rulers. This proved disastrous for the region once Grizaka cut off the path from Horashesh to Kheterat. With no royal aid to keep the governors in line and help them enforce order, all of Horashesh quickly descended into chaos, with both governors turning on each other and the local kings scrambling to usurp power from the royal governors. Luckily, with our capital much further south, we can govern the region in a more direct and unified manner. The Horasheshi can rest easy knowing that unlike the previous Kheterata, we will never lose control over their land.

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你讨厌阶层特权、严重灾难、文化与宗教门槛，或希望任务树一路延伸到全球征服，请避开。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期依靠地形、联盟和有限战争求生，中期北上夺取守护者地位并处理阿哈提危机，后期分方向改宗和整合各族、净化暗影沼泽并完成兽灾事件链。
player_overview.overview: 你是暗影沼泽边缘的人类—鹰身女妖共治小国，也是古代赫特拉塔王族的流亡后裔。前期要在强邻与法师夹击下求生，随后让鹰身女妖继承王位、收复哀伤河并重建阿哈提；中后期把豺狼人、蜥蜴人、侏儒和巨魔平等纳入国家，顶住阿哈提叛乱，净化暗影沼泽，最终让传奇屠魔者兽灾直面自己的种族灭绝遗产。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢艰难小国、优秀叙事、鹰身女妖军事、多族群制度、宗教理想主义和暗影探索的玩家。
signature_features: 人类行政与鹰身女妖军事并存，是少数能保留骑兵并发展飞行军队的鹰身女妖路线。
每整合一种族便解锁对应阶层特权和国家能力，最终把五类族群写入同一政治共同体。
深入暗影位面追查世界树、夜鬼婆、暗影巨魔和兽灾，以宽恕完成对传统英雄叙事的反转。
player_overview.tagline: 让人类王朝长出鹰身女妖的翅膀，以圣骑士、阿哈提和尼拉赫特的眼泪建立一个不再区分人与怪物的哀伤河帝国。

reasons: 多族群平等不是背景口号，而是任务条件、阶层特权和军队组成
人类骑兵与鹰身女妖军队形成罕见军事手感
阿赫特、阿哈提和兽灾把赫特拉塔与卡斯坦诺历史连成一条高密度叙事
